trigger: Independent VCS attack presented a malformed younger descriptor while a legal result was stalled and unaccepted.

counterexample.precondition: result_valid=1 and result_ready=0 for an older legal result
counterexample.observed: protocol_error asserts and result_valid_q is cleared before result_accept

required_repair: A malformed younger request may set a sticky ingress fault and stop new accepts, but must preserve and drain every older accepted result until result_accept; rerun production SVA with the stalled-output attack.
paper_safe_statement: M149's signed fold arithmetic and logic-only synthesis remain valid standalone evidence, but the r1 protocol is not integration-ready because a younger malformed request can erase an older stalled result.
